title: A C++ implementation of a fast hash map and hash set using hopscotch hashing
summary: A C++ header-only library implementing fast hash map and hash set data structures using hopscotch hashing algorithm, which provides efficient O(1) average lookups with excellent cache locality through neighborhood-based collision resolution.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of achieving consistent O(1) worst-case lookup time with good cache performance in hash tables, addressing the issues of chaining overhead and poor cache locality in traditional open addressing.
why_valuable: Provides a high-performance, cache-friendly alternative to std::unordered_map with deterministic O(1) worst-case lookups, making it ideal for real-time systems and latency-critical applications.
